feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 11:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 04 June 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure over Scotland will move slowly northeastwards into the North Sea, allowing a weak ridge of high pressure to build into the Irish Sea for a time tomorrow.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6 for the rest of today, occasionally 7 in east of the area at first, then slowly decreasing West 4 or 5 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning. Backing Southwest 4 or 5 later in morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling slight or moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Patchy rain, then showers later today, fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, possibly moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, backing South or Southeast later tomorrow, increasing occasionally 6 in the west of the area. Backing Southeast 6 or 7 overnight into Saturday, decreasing 4 or 5 on Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough for a time later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in rain and drizzle later.
